Lady Eliza and Lady Amelia Spencer Support Cousin Prince William In Style

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vanityfair.com/story/lady-eliza-spencer-lady-amelia-spencer-tusk-awards

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lady eliza and lady amelia spencer stepped out in style at the 2026 tusk conservation awards on wednesday. The annual awards ceremony recognizes and celebrates the leaders, researchers, and rangers working on the front lines to protect wildlife and ecosystems in Africa.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s a cause close to the sisters’ hearts, as they have spent much of their lives in south africa. It is no surprise, then, that they attended the London event and showed their support for their cousin, Prince William, who has supported the charity for many years.

For the occasion, the twin sisters pulled two of the most dazzling dresses from their collection and, in true sisterly fashion, opted for the same designer: Oscar de la Renta.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lady eliza spencer chose a strapless silver-toned midi dress with cutout details designed to create a sophisticated play of see-through effects. The shimmering texture makes it the perfect dress for the holidays, while the floral pattern, with its sculpted leaves, lends the whole look a romantic flair. In short, a harmonious blend of inspirations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to amplify the outfit’s radiance, a handbag studded with cubic crystals—a true crystal box also by oscar de la renta—and a pair of elegant nude-toned, satin-finish pumps by roger vivier. The precious touch? A pair of bling-bling comet-shaped earrings to illuminate the face.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, her sister amelia, by contrast, went all out in gold. She wore a refined ankle-length dress studded with sequins and fringes at the hem, giving the whole look a 1920s flair. The elegant, sophisticated look was completed with a gold clutch and a pair of pumps, also by Roger Vivier, featuring a precious buckle.

For jewelry, Amelia opted for a pair of diamond hoop earrings to sparkle in the light.

Berdasarkan laporan, charles spencer’s daughters were not the only cousins supporting prince william on this prestigious evening. Zara Tindall—daughter of Princess Anne—also attended. For the occasion, she wore a midnight-blue dress with short puff sleeves by Rebecca Wallace, featuring an exquisite collar and equally striking buttons, as if they were brooches borrowed from the royal jewelry box.

Zara Tindall and Emma Thynn, Marchioness of Bath.

Though it's a difficult pill to swallow, fans can take solace in the fact that Mickey Haller (Manuel Garcia-Rulfo) will get a proper outro — a much better outcome than an abrupt cancellation that would've left us all stranded on that Season 4 cliffhanger ending. Author Michael Connelly recently confirmed a March 2027 release window for the final chapter, and as we inch closer, new details about what to expect have begun to surface.

Diungkapkan bahwa as previously reported, the lincoln lawyer season 5 will adapt connelly's 2023 novel, resurrection walk, which serves as the seventh book in his mickey haller series. The new chapter will pick right up from the Season 4 finale, which ended with the shocking revelation that Emi Finch (Cobie Smulders) was Mickey's half-sister he never knew about. Filming for the season began in May and wrapped in July, with things now effectively in the post-production phase. Season 5 will center on the siblings teaming together in a case involving a woman wrongfully convicted for murdering her ex-husband.

Sebagaimana diketahui, those familiar with resurrection walk already have a good idea of what's coming, but certain disparities are to be expected given the show's tendency towards creative liberties. No order has been confirmed for the titles except for Episodes 5 and 6, titled Sucker Punch and Chemistry Problem, respectively. However, this time around, fans can expect a story as close to the book as possible as suggested by the recently unveiled episode titles, which include clear ties to the book. Episodes 1–4, will, non-chronologically, include the titles: Article 1, Section 9; Artemisia; Roots; and Table 12, while Episodes 7-10 will include the titles Do or Die; Footprints; Overtime; and Resurrection Walk.

Diungkapkan bahwa you are the friend who makes things happen, and so is she. Together you would be mildly exhausting to everyone around you and completely delighted with yourselves.

Diungkapkan bahwa you have no patience for pleasant lies, and she has no ability to tell them. What looks like coldness from the outside is the most reliable friendship on this list.

Berdasarkan laporan, you look after whoever is having the worst day. So does he. It is the least strategic way to move through the world and the best possible quality in a friend.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the lincoln lawyer season 5 will mark the end of an era and possibly, with intention, herald the start of another. News of the show's cancellation was followed by the announcement that Netflix was developing a spin-off that will center on Emi Finch, with Smulders set to reprise the role. The spin-off is reportedly in the works for a quick turnaround and, as such, The Lincoln Lawyer Season 5, Episode 10 could likely serve to tee up Emi's upcoming story. It's not clear if the spin-off will feature Mickey Haller, but given their relationship, there's certainly a likelihood that Haller will remain a part of the story much like with Harry Bosch's within the expanding Bosch universe on Prime Video.

Berdasarkan laporan, we’re over halfway through the 2026 fall tv schedule, and i need to talk about one unexpected highlight in my weekly viewing. It’s about two middle-aged people, Jeanie and James, who fall in love, and decide to quickly get married. It feels like a classic sitcom from the ‘90s like The Nanny, Will & Grace or Frasier that just don't get made anymore. They are pretty much opposites, but love each other enough to merge their different lives despite it. It’s nothing groundbreaking, but that’s one reason why I appreciate it it. It’s like watching an ongoing romantic comedy with a mix of humor and earnestness.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jamie lee curtis plays james’ meddling ex-wife claudia, who’s always showing up at the worst times to annoy them, and i love how audacious her character is. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the stress of getting into a new show is always the fear of cancellation, and i’m seeing signs for newlyweds already. The Connors producer Bruce Helford was promptly hired to take over, but issues like this so early in a show’s life is concerning.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the tv ratings guide also predicts the show “leans cancellation” after its underwhelming reviews and viewership so far. The show is only three episodes in, but I don’t see much buzz for it at all. It can’t make Peacock’s top ten and Television Stats reports a very low amount of online engagement about it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it also airs on friday nights, which has famously led to a bunch of cancellations for nbc, recently for shows like stumble, lopez vs. It’s a shame that NBC’s only new comedy this season could be dead on arrival, especially considering all the great sitcoms the network has produced over the years. Lopez and Young Rock. NBC’s other new show, Line of Fire, reportedly isn’t doing so hot either.

Diungkapkan bahwa i’ll still be watching newlyweds every week because i’m enjoying all its '90s nostalgia, and curtis’s hilarious character, but i guess if it doesn't move forward i can't say i didn't see it coming. I don’t think it’s quite too late to make it a hit, so do me (and yourself) a favor and check it out!.

#142. Ebenezer Review: Johnny Depp Neither Helps Nor Hurts This Passionless Retelling

📅 12 Nov 2026

Ebenezer Review: Johnny Depp Neither Helps Nor Hurts This Passionless Retelling

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2314564/ebenezer-review-johnny-depp-a-christmas-carol-movie/

Berdasarkan laporan, charles dickens' 1843 novella "a christmas carol" is one of the greatest stories ever written. It's a tale that is both very much of its time as well as timeless, speaking to systemic issues of cold-hearted greed and inequality as well as the ability to change one's ways for the better. It's a malleable text that can be calibrated for all ages, just as it can be told with everything from a lighthearted touch to a more dour and sinister horror-centric one.

Diungkapkan bahwa this versatility has led it to become one of the most commonly adapted stories of all time. To put it mildly, we are not lacking for versions of Dickens' "Christmas Carol. " That doesn't mean further adaptations shouldn't be made, but rather that the artists behind them should have a unique take on the material; like Shakespeare, it's well known enough to not have to play completely straight.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, yet playing it straight seems to be the entire ethos for "ebenezer," the new adaptation from director ti west and starring johnny depp as scrooge. That seems to be what West and company are assuming with Depp in the role, and it's likely why the rest of the film around him isn't taking too many big swings. Scott have done. Yet it leaves "Ebenezer" feeling a little too plain on the one hand, and potentially unsavory where Depp's personal status is considered. If a "Christmas Carol" adaptation isn't taking a big swerve with either a singing Will Ferrell or Muppets, for example, the general assumption is that some renowned actor will give their take on Scrooge, as luminaries like Alastair Sim, Albert Finney, and George C. It's a movie that seems to exist on Depp's shoulders for better or worse, a choice that leaves it being technically competent but ultimately confused.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you already know "a christmas carol," then "ebenezer" will not hold many surprises for you. Ti West and screenwriter Nathaniel Halpern treat Charles Dickens' novella in much the same way the Royal Shakespeare Company might treat "Hamlet," which is to say that they retain the bulk of Dickens' dialogue and structure (the film is even separated into five staves, as in the novella) while coloring outside the lines ever so often. After an original opening sequence detailing the literal end of the partnership between Marley (Ian McKellen) and Ebenezer Scrooge (Johnny Depp), the film chronicles the usual beats of the tale, from establishing Scrooge's miserly, calloused attitude to the gradual thawing of his soul via his haunting by three Christmas ghosts.

Although Paramount Pictures' ghastly marketing campaign promised that "Ebenezer" would present a Scrooge we'd never seen before and go places other adaptations hadn't dared, the true extent of any changes or embellishments to the Dickens tale lies in the way that certain very small supporting characters who purport to either be in service of the needy or in need themselves are revealed to be greedy con artists.

Berdasarkan laporan, the choice does add a nice little layer of moral complexity to what is typically a straightforward story, yet west and company don't do all that much with it in the end. Given his extensive indie horror background, West does lend the proceedings a welcome macabre aesthetic. The three ghosts are especially ghastly and eerie, and the whole film has a Victorian London by way of '70s British films feel to it, like if Ronald Neame's "Scrooge" was mashed up with West's "The Innkeepers. This is certainly the spookiest "Christmas Carol" since Robert Zemeckis' bizarre 2006 version. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, while much of "ebenezer" is solid and skillfully crafted, it's all clearly in service of the character and the performer at its center. To say that Johnny Depp brings some baggage to the role is to make an understatement, for even setting aside the considerable issue of his offscreen life, his onscreen persona would be its own monolith to reckon with. Especially in this material, as it blatantly conjures up his past successes with director Tim Burton.

Diungkapkan bahwa what made the depp/burton duo special was how the director was able to draw out some truly bizarre character choices from the actor while making sure the film around him fit the outrageous, heightened tone of the performance. Here in "Ebenezer," Depp appears to be shooting more for respectable prestige than crowd-pleasing outrageousness. He's not trying to pull a Jack Sparrow, in other words, and instead is letting the prosthetic makeup do much of the transformation for him.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with the exception of a small moment here and there, depp's scrooge is largely solid yet unremarkable. It's possible that Depp now considers such an approach something he's no longer interested in, and it's not like he hasn't given grounded performances before, like his turn as John Dillinger in "Public Enemies," for example. Which begs the question: why bother in the first place? It seems like the entirety of "Ebenezer" was arranged to allow Depp to chew scenery and showboat around, which the actor perversely refuses to do. Depp's performance as Scrooge simply doesn't feel fully realized. It's fine on paper, and even has flashes of depth, yet it ultimately is more calibrated than inspired.

Berdasarkan laporan, i have a deep affection for "a christmas carol," and generally find something to like in all of its many adaptations. Ti West, Nathaniel Halpern, Depp and the rest haven't twisted the story beyond recognition, nor have they sullied it. In this way, "Ebenezer" is no different. Yet in playing things so generally safe, "Ebenezer" becomes a muted film.

Sebagaimana diketahui, west throws in a flourish here and there, like the great work with the three ghost characters or a moment where scrooge is abducted through his bed that deliberately recalls depp's cinematic debut in "a nightmare on elm street. " There's even an extended denouement to the tale which stands in contrast to most versions of "A Christmas Carol," where instead of rushing through Scrooge's change of heart, the film takes its time as the man makes his reparations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yet even that choice feels calculated in a meta sense to better present johnny depp, movie star, back to the public after his cancellation. Even with that held back, it feels like "Ebenezer" is more a proving ground than impassioned adaptation, with West demonstrating he can do more than just indie horror, and Depp showing more of his restraint as a performer. After all, this story is famously one about a loathsome man who learns contrition and seeks to make amends, and while the film itself never breaks the fourth wall with this idea, it comes damn close. What will happen to Depp the person is not for me to say, but he's going to have to work harder and take more risks than "Ebenezer" if he wants to give his screen career a second chance.

"Ebenezer" opens in theaters on November 13, 2026.

#145. Kate Middleton Opens Up About Her Cancer Recovery: “It Will Take Time”

📅 12 Nov 2026

Kate Middleton Opens Up About Her Cancer Recovery: “It Will Take Time”

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vanityfair.com/story/kate-middleton-cancer-recovery

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kate middleton has spoken about her cancer diagnosis and long treatment journey in a lengthy interview for country life magazine, conducted by writer robert macfarlane, an author known for his books on landscapes and the natural world. This special issue features Prince William as a guest editor, following in the footsteps of other members of the British royal family who previously served as guest editors for Country Life, including King Charles, Queen Camilla, and Princess Anne.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i was told in hospital that my recovery would not be linear. There will be good days and bad days, that it will take time,” said the Princess of Wales. “It shows us that periods of rest, reflection, and renewal are equally as important as moments of growth,” said Kate. As such, her love of nature played a vital role during her treatment. This perspective offers a different view of recovery: not as a phase to be overcome as quickly as possible, but as a time when pausing, listening to oneself, and replenishing one’s energy becomes an integral part of the healing process.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the interview, she also spoke about the therapeutic value of the natural environment, to which she has always shown a particular affinity. “Whether it is the beach for healing and recovery, the countryside for peace and perspective, or the mountains to find solitude, people have long sought comfort in the natural world. It is such a restorative environment, and incorporating nature into someone’s recovery pathway is vital,” she said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after experiencing illness firsthand, the princess was particularly interested in a holistic approach to treatment and healing. Yes, serious illness creates a lot of physical challenges, but there is also a deeper part to all of us. “What I feel really passionate about, having had firsthand experience, is approaching illness and recovery through a whole-person approach. Nature has allowed me to find a deeper connection to my mind, body, and spirit,” she said.

Diungkapkan bahwa kate then explained what she found in the natural environment and why she considers it so precious: “it doesn’t ask anything of us. It simply allows us to be. ” She continued, “It really has been my sanctuary and a place I’ve instinctively wanted to go. It doesn’t judge us or expect us to perform. ”.

The Princess of Wales playing with a little girl.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the princess of wales reflected on her childhood, recounting how she spent a great deal of time outdoors from a very young age. “I remember from a very early age spending a lot of time in nature, playing in streams, walking in the countryside, blackberry picking, or simply time alone in my own world, enjoying the simplicity of ordinary things. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, among the memories she shared is one that’s particularly evocative: when she used to dig under bushes, convinced she’d find treasure. “When we are little, we seem to notice things more. A simple game, born of a little girl’s imagination, that transformed a corner of the garden into a place full of possibilities. Sadly, this is something I think we lose touch with as adults. “There was always a sense of freedom I felt in nature, something about being outdoors that is hard to find elsewhere,” she explained. Like the changing light through the trees, the sound of water, the joy of crunching leaves or finding a feather. These moments can seem ordinary, but, often, they’re the things we remember most. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to the princess, as we grow up, we risk losing this ability to observe and appreciate the little details. Life becomes more hectic, commitments multiply, and we end up forgetting how important it is to stop, slow down, and pay attention to the little things.

The smiling princess at Chase Community Hospital in Bordon.

Diungkapkan bahwa at one point, macfarlane asked the princess of wales a particularly profound question: where does she find hope? the writer observed that, in his view, despair is almost a luxury we cannot afford. Kate responded by returning to the theme running through the conversation: the lessons of the natural world. “We might not be able to have certainty or control every outcome, but we can do the small things, and those small things add up and do make a difference, if we nurture what is around us and have faith. “I find hope in the lessons nature teaches us: that, despite the challenges life may throw at us, we are not alone, and that we are interconnected with something bigger than ourselves,” she said. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa kate went public with her cancer diagnosis in march 2024, after undergoing abdominal surgery in january of that same year. At that time, however, she had already made it clear that the end of treatment would not automatically mean a full recovery: “Although I have finished chemotherapy, my path to healing and full recovery is long and I must continue to take each day as it comes. I am, however, looking forward to being back at work and undertaking a few more public engagements in the coming months when I can. The news shocked the entire world. In September 2024, she announced that she had completed her course of chemotherapy. ”.

Kate at Chase Community Hospital in Bordon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kate also spoke in the interview about her approach to motherhood, emphasizing her desire to give her children—prince george, princess charlotte, and prince louis—the freedom to explore the world at their own pace and according to their own curiosity. “It is something I remind myself to do with my own children; to give them freedom to explore, rather than constantly telling them what to see or what to think,” she said.

Diungkapkan bahwa the princess then expressed a specific concern: the rising anxiety among those in younger generations, who spend an increasingly significant portion of their lives online and surrounded by technology. “What worries me is the growing anxiety among children and young people. It’s a generation that’s more online and connected to tech than ever before," she stated. Nature is a natural environment where those skills can be built. “In this increasingly digital world, I believe it is more important than ever that children grow up with a strong sense of belonging, connection, and emotional security. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa interaction with the environment, she explained, offers children opportunities to practice important skills through hands-on experiences. It is essential for our well-being. “Whether it’s collecting leaves, building something from sticks, climbing a tree, or simply observing the world around them, children are constantly learning and discovering, about themselves, other people, and the world around them. “Nature also encourages curiosity, imagination, and creativity,” she said. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, macfarlane then linked these observations to the princess’s work on early childhood. He noted that Kate has repeatedly emphasized the importance of the first five years of life and asked her how nature could contribute to laying the foundations for development. The princess emphasized how central relationships are during early childhood: “So much of early childhood is about building nurturing environments that allow strong relationships to grow. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the princess explained that a child gradually develops various relationships: with themselves, with their parents or caregivers, with other children, and with the world around them. “The natural world gives children an extraordinary environment in which to develop those relationships,” she said. In this regard, she recalled her visit to Reggio Emilia, Italy—an experience she described as particularly meaningful because it allowed her to rediscover many of the principles that guide the work of her Centre for Early Childhood.

Diungkapkan bahwa among these is the importance of relationships, the environment, experiences, and, above all, the ability to truly listen to children. “Nature wasn’t another lesson; it offered an integral space that encouraged questions, that stimulated imagination, curiosity, and collaboration,” she explained.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on the very same day the interview was published, kate visited chase community hospital in bordon, hampshire, to learn firsthand about the expansion of a project supported by the royal foundation’s centre for early childhood. The initiative aims to help identify more infants who, along with their families, may need additional support during the first months and years of life. During the visit, the princess met with health care workers, professionals, and families involved in using the Alarm Distress Baby Scale, known by the acronym ADBB. This observation tool, which she learned about during her visit to Copenhagen, enables health care providers to identify early signs of social and relational withdrawal in children.

The princess with some health care workers.

#146. Why The Lord Of The Rings: The Rings Of Power Season 3 Feels Like A Reboot [Exclusive]

📅 12 Nov 2026

Why The Lord Of The Rings: The Rings Of Power Season 3 Feels Like A Reboot [Exclusive]

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2314477/why-the-lord-of-the-ring-the-rings-of-power-season-3-feels-like-reboot/

Berdasarkan laporan, keep it secret, keep it safe. from spoilers. This article discusses major plot details from Episodes 1-4 of "The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power" Season 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the world is changed," cate blanchett's galadriel intones in the very first words of "the lord of the rings: the fellowship of the ring. " In the Peter Jackson film, the Elven royal is mourning the passing of the ages. The Season 3 premiere quickly establishes that, following a five-year time jump, Middle-earth is not the same as before. In "The Rings of Power," viewers may feel a similar sense of time slipping by as they tune into the first four episodes released by Prime Video. War rages, certain characters now play very different roles, and things have never felt quite so dire.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the rings of power" may still struggle to live up to the hype, but there's no mistaking that sense of starting over this time around. After a relatively up-and-down journey to this point, was Season 3 meant to be a creative reset for newcomers to jump on board? That was one of my biggest burning questions when I sat down with series co-showrunner Patrick McKay during a recent press junket. While stopping just short of endorsing a complete 180-degree pivot in approach, he admitted this was very much intended to keep viewers on their toes:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the big thing is, honestly, we want to keep shaking things up. Seasons 1 and 2 kind of roll straight through, linearly. And this time, it felt like a good opportunity to shake things up and drop you in a story in a place you're not expecting. We want to surprise the audience. We want to come at you with a pitch you haven't seen yet. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa for those who've watched all four episodes released to this point, it's abundantly clear that "the rings of power" isn't messing around this season. Not only has Charlie Vickers' Sauron finally unmasked himself and declared open war upon all free peoples, but the writers themselves have developed a bit of a ruthless streak. Multiple characters are killed off in the early going, neither of whom had much of a place in the ongoing story anymore, while even the Hobbit-like clan of Harfoots from Seasons 1 and 2 are now completely missing in action.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, taken as a whole, it's a promising (if overdue) development for viewers who have struggled with the show's unwieldy ensemble cast and patience-testing armada of subplots. After a few table-setting sequences, Season 3 begins with a major battle sequence that confirms how overmatched our heroes really are. Sauron's power has grown, his fearsome proto-Ringwraiths (known as Nazgnagôl) are now in thrall, and, of course, the threat of the One Ring overshadows everything. For Patrick McKay, however, this all goes back to the desire to avoid lulling viewers into a predictable pattern of storytelling,  instead coming right out of the gate swinging. As McKay told me, this season was the perfect opportunity to take a really big swing:.

Berdasarkan laporan, "that was very much a conscious choice. We [previously] built to big events and big battles. And we love those seasons, I'm very proud of them. We wanted to invert the structure of the prior couple seasons. But we wanted to do something different and we felt like, 'What if we started with a battle? What if we started at the height of the war and then maybe hit the ground running?'.

Berdasarkan laporan, there's a lot to be said for spending years carefully establishing the tone and structure of a mega-budget streaming show. As "The Rings of Power" hits its middle act in Season 3 (remember, this was planned to last five full seasons), the timing couldn't be better to kick things into another gear. only to upend the board at its halfway point. As the villains of the story gain the upper hand and our heroes race to catch up, the creative team applied a similar mindset to the experience of actually watching this season unfold.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "look, as viewers, j. [Payne], my co-showrunner and I, we love chasing a show," Patrick McKay revealed to me. D. " That, as it turns out, helped influence their decision to pull a similar trick with "The Rings of Power. "When you're in a movie theater, and you can feel an audience keying in and chasing the film, it's always great, and it makes your investment even more powerful. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "if you're entering a story at a point where it's in medias res and you've got to kind of figure it out and [you go], 'oh wow, galadriel and arondir [the elf character played by ismael cruz córdova] are friends now and, oh my gosh, barad-dûr has been built and oh, that must be rivendell and what is this?' it's kind of an exciting way to watch something. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, clearly, the hope is for this chapter of "the rings of power" to provide a jolt and give fans reason to stick around. After the four-episode premiere, we have half a season left to see where this goes. Two new episodes drop on Prime Video on November 18, 2026.

A measles outbreak on Grey’s Anatomy led to a main character revealing their chronic illness diagnosis — and temporarily leaving the hospital.

During the Thursday, November 12, episode of the hit ABC series, Wes (Trevor Jackson) and Simone (Alexis Floyd) were at odds after she told him her ex-boyfriend Lucas (Niko Terho) — whom she recently hooked up with — was moving into the same house as her.

Berdasarkan laporan, instead, wes revealed he had cvid (common variable immunodeficiency) and the condition prevented him from being able to get vaccinated. His body does not produce enough antibodies to fight off germs effectively, so he had to leave the hospital for 28 days while they waited to see if he would develop symptoms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, elsewhere in the episode, jo (camilla luddington) delivered friend corrie’s (sarah levy) baby in the back of an ambulance after major complications. Instead of being triggered by the procedure, Jo realized she wanted to return to work.

Diungkapkan bahwa amelia (caterina scorsone), meanwhile, was starting to pick up on signs that link (chris carmack) was addicted to the pain pills he prescribed for himself. Kwan (Harry Shum Jr. ) faced his own issues when his dad arrived at the hospital to allegedly reconnect amid his terminal cancer diagnosis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kwan initially believed his father, who was absent all his life, but with jules’ (adelaide kane) help, he realized his dad was trying to manipulate him into donating his bone marrow. Cracks also began to emerge in Ben (Jason George) and Miranda’s (Chandra Wilson) marriage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, grey’s anatomy has had its fair share of shakeups this season with an even more limited number of episodes. The medical drama previously had as many as 27 episodes per season, but this year, there are only 13.

Despite the major changes, executive producer Meg Marinis is holding out hope that some former cast members might find a way to return this season.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i hope so! we love bringing former cast [members] back when they’re available and it makes sense story-wise,” she told the hollywood reporter in october. “We have some ideas percolating, so I’m hopeful we’ll have some fun nostalgic surprises for fans this season. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, grey’s anatomy airs on abc thursdays at 10 p. m. ET before streaming the next day on Hulu.

Ahead of Mariska Hargitay celebrating the 600th episode of Law & Order: SVU, which she’s led  for more than 25 years a, her eight-figure salary was revealed.

Some members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit are earning the big bucks.

Berdasarkan laporan, after all, with mariska hargitay starring as captain olivia benson on law & order: svu for more than 25 years and serving as executive producer since season 15, she is taking home nearly $850,000 per episode for season 28, according to a nov. 12 Variety report.

Along with earning millions each season—which usually consists of  20 to 25 episodes—the Emmy winner is celebrating another high point in her career: 600 episodes.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it really doesn't feel totally real—which in a way is exactly how it should feel, because it's as if we all get to live in this dream of what you thought might be possible someday," she said during a celebration dinner attended by variety. "You've shown that it's not only possible, but it's so much better than anyone could have imagined. ".

Hargitay—who also founded nonprofit Joyful Heart Foundation in 2004—even closed the case on what the milestone episode would be about.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it's about a woman having her voice and being submissive or subservient in a way, or giving up our power or our instinct, and that's an important story to tell," she continued. "Because so many women identify with that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa plus, her longtime onscreen counterpart  christopher meloni, who has made a few guest appearances on svu since leaving in 2011, is set to return. (His Elliott Stabler-centered spinoff Organized Crime was canceled by NBC in April after five seasons. ).

While the crime drama is still going strong nearly three decades later, Hargitay has considered putting down her badge for good.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i have thought about that," she told e! news in october. "Not yet. Just thought about it for way later. But I'm open. ".

But when she does finally bid farewell to Benson, Hargitay knows she'll still be doing what she's meant to be.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i'm a very active person with a lot of irons in the fire," she noted. I trust that the future will be right and that I will be where I'm supposed to be. "I am somebody who follows the signs. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "i'm very engaged and fulfilled at svu right now," she continued, "and there's definitely things that i want to do and achieve and challenge myself with. ".

#150. Pixar's New Movie Gatto Gets First In-Depth Look in Official Trailer

Pixar's New Movie Gatto Gets First In-Depth Look in Official Trailer

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/pixar-gatto-trailer/

Go on a trip to Venice with Pixar's Gatto.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first teaser for gatto, pixar's upcoming animated film, was released on jun. 11, following a description of the movie's general plot and some cast members. Fans learned that Gatto is set in the Italian city of Venice, and it follows the adventures of a feral black cat named Nero, who's spent most of his nine lives recklessly working for mobster cat Rocco.

Diungkapkan bahwa the story sounded promising, and the animation style was charming, to say the least. On Thursday, Nov. Fans were eager to get another mobster cat adventure movie. 12, Pixar published a 2-minute trailer that gives us a better look at each character in Gatto and dives deeper into the plot.

Diungkapkan bahwa according to the trailer, after losing eight of his nine lives and coming down to a single whisker, nero starts to question whether he's wasted them. When Rocco tells him to steal a street musician's violin, Nero discovers his love for music and forms a friendship instead. This is a turning point, and Nero realizes he must survive the dangers that lurk in Venice and find his purpose.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, written and directed by enrico casaroca and produced by andrea warren, gatto is being developed by the same creators who made luca (2021), a beloved pixar film that was nominated for best animated feature. Academy Award winner Dario Marianelli (Atonement, Pride & Prejudice) is in charge of the score. He is working alongside Slovak violinist Barbora Botošová.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for the main cast, mark ruffalo will take on the role of nero, and laurence fishburne will play rocco, the mobster boss persian cat. Other feline and human characters will be played by Bianca Babaşa, Sherry Cola, John Turturro, Rumen Sali Shopov, Rhys Darby, Isabella Rossellini, Natasia Demetriou, Jamie Demetriou, Jason Schwartzman, Saverio Raimondo, Jason Mantzoukas, Matt Jones, Austin Madison, Beatrice Manfredi, Jesse Andrews, Tracey Ullman, and Marco Calvani.

Berdasarkan laporan, gatto premieres in theaters on march 5, 2027. Before the movie begins, Disney and Pixar's Loving Dory, a new animated short in the Finding Nemo series, will play. Loving Dory is a story about Dory falling in love with. a plastic bag that she mistakes for a jellyfish. Unfortunately, the relationship turns toxic and obsessive, and someone must step in to help.

Disney laid off between 100 and 150 Pixar employees.

Diungkapkan bahwa the gen-z comedy, adults, dropped its sophomore season on fx and hulu as part of the 2026 tv schedule back in august, and since then fans have been loudly campaigning for another season. After months of waiting, the series was officially renewed for a Season 3, much to the delight of the fans.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cast took to instagram to share the news with their devoted viewers, which included the reveal that the third season will include 16 original episodes, nearly double the length of the first two seasons. As a massive fan of the show and a firm believer that sitcoms need more episodes, I’m thrilled at the news! In fact, I’m so excited I’ve already compiled a list of things I absolutely need the extended season to feature.

Berdasarkan laporan, holiday episodes used to be a sitcom staple, but as television seasons started getting shorter and shorter, these episodes started to disappear. I had accepted the fact that I would never get to see my favorite characters celebrate birthdays or the holiday season, but now that might not be the case.

Berdasarkan laporan, with a 16-episode season comes space for these beloved one-off episodes. Just think of all the hijinks that could ensue from the Adults gang trying to celebrate the holidays. Now imagine it’s the holiday season and Paul Baker’s family decides to make the trek to New York to spend Christmas with their son and his new husband after his sister lets it slip that he’s married. We’ve already seen them struggle to host a sophisticated dinner party in the first season. The shenanigans would be hilarious!.

Diungkapkan bahwa over the course of the first two seasons, adults has found time to include some fun guest stars like actor charlie cox, actress/model julia fox, and sitcom royalty raven-symoné. I’m sure the tradition will continue in Season 3, and I have some ideas on whom the creators should reach out to.

Berdasarkan laporan, since adults films in canada, it makes total sense that the gen-z show should approach a breakout gen-z actor who also appears on a hit canadian-produced show. Yes, I’m talking about Heated Rivalry’s Hudson Williams. Williams could play himself and act as an old friend from Paul Baker’s childhood, since he canonically grew up in Canada and has a history of befriending famous people without realizing it.

Diungkapkan bahwa another obvious, albeit more difficult to get, choice would be new york’s mayor zohran mamdani. I can totally see Issa finding a way to reach out to the Mayor about some minor inconvenience affecting her city that no one else cares about.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, season 2 ended on a major high note with paul baker and anton finally getting together, but it also shocked fans with a plot twist in the final moments that featured billie and samir hooking up. Don’t get me wrong, I can’t wait to see Paul Baker and Anton enter their “relationship era,” but I’m also excited to see what shenanigans Billie and Samir get into now that they’ve crossed such a huge line in their friendship.

Diungkapkan bahwa on one hand, i’d love billie and samir to channel the relationship between chandler and monica from friends and try to keep their hookup and subsequent relationship a secret from the rest of the house. It would be difficult considering how close they all are, but definitely worth it to keep it away from everyone meddling.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, i could also see them trying to act as if their hookup was casual and something they can continue doing without catching feelings. Neither Billie nor Samir do anything without their whole heart involved, so this would be a recipe for disaster but also great for laughs.

Berdasarkan laporan, season 3 has so much room for fun and hijinks with its longer episode order, and i can’t wait to see what the writers come up with. While it’ll be a while before the new season is out, fans can stream the first two seasons with a Hulu subscription now.

#153. The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping Will Be A Bigger Box Office Hit Than You Realize

📅 12 Nov 2026

The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping Will Be A Bigger Box Office Hit Than You Realize

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2313974/the-hunger-games-sunrise-on-the-reaping-box-office-preview/

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the biggest expected hits of the fall season is nearly upon us — and it's going to be even bigger than a lot of people realize. "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" will explore Haymitch Abernathy's origin story, with Woody Harrelson having popularized the character in the original run of "Hunger Games" films. This time, Joseph Zada is playing the younger Haymitch, and it turns out folks are very eager to see how he ended up winning his games in his youth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once again directed by franchise shepherd francis lawrence, "sunrise on the reaping" is currently eyeing a monster box office opening between $105 and $140 million domestically when it arrives next weekend, per box office theory. These estimates have climbed a lot in recent weeks, so I'm personally included to lean on the higher end of projections. Either way, it's going to be a dramatic improvement for the property.

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2023, "the hunger games: the ballad of songbirds and snakes" topped the box office, but lionsgate wasn't partying like it's 2012. 6 million en route to $349 million worldwide. All of "The Hunger Games" movies have been hits at the box office, yet that prequel's grosses were far behind the previous entries, which all opened north of $100 million and made at least $650 million worldwide. It opened to $44. This latest prequel is, by all appearances, going to be more in line with those earlier entries.

Berdasarkan laporan, "sunrise on the reaping" takes place more than two decades before the first-ever "hunger games" film/book and four decades after "the ballad of songbirds & snakes. " Its story is focused on the 50th annual Hunger Games, aka the Second Quarter Quell, in which Haymitch famously competed and won before mentoring Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) in the 74th Hunger Games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why is the latest "hunger games" prequel expected to perform so much better than its predecessor? for one, author suzanne collins' source novel was incredibly well received, telling a story many have been curious about for a long time. For another, Jennifer Lawrence is reprising Katniss for "Sunrise on the Reaping," with Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson coming back as Peeta Mellark and the older Haymitch as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa while these appearances should be fairly brief, getting the band back together absolutely helps make this more of an event for fans. Similarly, "The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes" was about the insidious President Snow's origins, whereas casual audiences are probably more interested in learning about Haymich's backstory. Lionsgate spent over/under $200 million to make "Sunrise on the Reaping," which was risky in light of how "Songbirds and Snakes" performed, but it's currently shaping up to be money well spent.

Diungkapkan bahwa the last time the franchise saw a hit of this size was when 2015's "the hunger games: mockingjay — part 2" opened to $102 million domestically en route to $653 million in theaters worldwide. If this film opens on the higher end of projections? It could be closer to "Catching Fire" ($158 million opening/$865 million worldwide). Either way, this is going to be the biggest opening of the fall season to date, by far.

Diungkapkan bahwa early reactions to "sunrise on the reaping" have been largely positive, which also bodes well. And while Thanksgiving will bring in big competition like "Focker In-Law" and Disney's "Hexed," it falls over one of the biggest moviegoing weeks of the year. As such, all these films should be able to co-exist.

"The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" hits theaters on November 20, 2026.

It takes place in the late 1970s and focuses on a former rodeo star named Mike Milo (Eastwood) who takes a job from an ex‐boss to bring his young son home, taking him away from his alcoholic mom. Crossing rural Mexico on their back way to Texas, the unlikely pair faces an unexpectedly challenging journey.

Diungkapkan bahwa be that as it may, more than five years later, people appear to be catching up with this one now that it's on a new platform and available to watch from the comfort of home. The film's current popularity speaks volumes about Clint Eastwood's continued draw as an American cinema icon, both as an actor and a director. Westerns, in particular, have been the bread and butter for him dating back to his early days as an actor.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the legendary filmmaker has starred in many classics of the genre, including "the good, the bad, and the ugly" and "unforgiven," arguably the best movie directed by eastwood. So even if "Cry Macho" wasn't considered to be among his best works as a director, it still scratches an itch for viewers — especially viewers who have a certain nostalgia for Eastwood wearing a cowboy hat and boots.

Berdasarkan laporan, /film called "cry macho" an "old-fashioned cowboy drama" in our review from 2021. What makes the movie significant, above all else, is that it's probably going to serve as Eastwood's swan song within the genre and could quite possibly mark his final on-screen performance. It was a mixed review overall, which is pretty much how most critics felt about it. He's well into his 90s and there is a decent chance he's effectively retired at this point.

Berdasarkan laporan, 2024's intense courtroom drama "juror #2" was expected to be eastwood's final go-around as a director, which notably didn't feature him as an actor. Bearing that in mind, it's probably worth watching "Cry Macho" for a great many folks, if only as a send-off of sorts to one of the greatest to ever do it in the genre he's mostly closely associated with.

Diungkapkan bahwa as someone who makes it a point to watch all the new streaming and made-for-tv holiday movies, including the entire hallmark countdown to christmas lineup, i’m pretty used to plot holes, and they don't bother me much. Sebagaimana diketahui, the premiere of hulu's 12 dates of christmas on the 2026 tv schedule serves as a mini reunion for pretty little liars fans, as it reunites hale and harding for the holiday flick. Hale plays Christina, a workaholic who owns a furniture restoration shop and has made little time for finding her romantic soulmate. After a disastrous family Christmas Eve dinner, Christina makes a promise to herself and her mom that by next year she’ll have someone to bring to it. Of course, the year gets away from her, which leads her best friend (Kahyun Kim) to set up a string of dates for Christina to go on in the twelve weeks leading up to Christmas Eve.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the midst of the endless stream of disastrous dates, christina reconnects with her high school crush peter (harding), who commissions christina to refurbish a beloved loveseat for the home he’s remodeling with the help of local mean girl bridget (greer grammer). Berdasarkan laporan, it’s no surprise that hale and harding have amazing chemistry and make it easy to root for their characters to get their happily ever after despite the obstacles between them. However, after the infamous hospital scene, I felt myself growing more and more confused as to why Chrsitina’s family seemed to not know who Peter was, considering Christina had a crush on him in high school.

Netflix’s A Dog’s Perfect Christmas Made Me Cry, But Not For The Reasons I Thought.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sure, not every daughter shares their high school crush with their family, but christina’s family is the meddling type, especially her mom. Diungkapkan bahwa not to mention, this is a christmas romance movie, which means the town christina grew up in and still calls home isn’t a big one. All the more reason for her family to at least recognize Peter’s name, especially since he’s renovating his family’s home.

Berdasarkan laporan, ultimately, christina’s family not knowing who peter is isn’t that big of a deal. However, I do think it would have been a fun twist if they did recognize him because it would make them meddle in her love life even more. Still, 12 Dates of Christmas is a cute and festive Christmas flick that anyone with a Hulu subscription should definitely check out.

Boom!" (for which he did earn a Best Actor nomination).

Boom!" about his struggles to make it in musical theater, coming on the heels of his failed futuristic musical "Superbia. Boom!" way more. Garfield's performance as Larson is electrifying, pitch-perfect, and gripping, and he should have an Oscar for it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the "plot" of "tick. Tick. Boom!" is relatively simple — Andrew Garfield plays Jonathan Larson as he works days at the Moondance Diner and spends his free time perfecting that aforementioned musical "Superbia" for an upcoming workshop. Along the way, he grapples with the idea of leaving the arts behind for a more lucrative and stable career — like his best friend Michael (Robin de Jesús), who works for an ad agency — while also stressing about turning 30 years old.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you're familiar with "rent," you may not be surprised to learn that the hiv-aids crisis plays a role; his friend freddy (ben levi ross) is hiv-positive, and it's eventually revealed that michael is as well. As Jonathan tries to manage his personal and professional lives, he crosses paths with his idol Stephen Sondheim (played by Bradley Whitford, though the real Sondheim did lend his voice to an answering machine message before he passed away in 2021) and frets about whether or not "Superbia" has any chance of success.

Berdasarkan laporan, usually, the gift of hindsight doesn't really serve an actor, but i think knowing that larson passed away before "rent" won a pulitzer prize (and tonys) gives garfield a great perspective here. His Jonathan is frenetic, a live wire, and lives his life to the fullest; Garfield's passionate performance throughout the film paints a picture of a man who's running out of time, and even though that's obviously expressed through the character's anxieties about turning 30, it's also a poignant representation of an artist whose life was cut tragically short. and in numbers like "Why," "30/90," and "Louder than Words," Garfield pays perfect homage to Larson's life and legacy.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think i've been pretty clear about the fact that andrew garfield should have an oscar for "tick. Tick. Boom!" ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, under careful direction from david fincher and working with one of aaron sorkin's all-time best scripts — which he ultimately betrayed with his dog-brained sequel "the social reckoning" — garfield is extraordinary as eduardo, best friend to jesse eisenberg's mark zuckerberg who provides money and support during the initial founding of facebook. In one timeline, we see Mark and Eduardo as Harvard University students trying to get their social media platform off the ground; in another, we see Eduardo suing Mark after Mark cruelly cuts Eduardo out of the company and brings his shares down drastically on the advice of new partner Sean Parker (a ridiculously well-cast Justin Timberlake).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, garfield should probably have several awards just for the way he delivers the line "sorry, my prada's at the cleaners, along with my hoodie and my f***-you flip flops" to eisenberg's mark after he discovers his betrayal. Garfield needs to be taken more seriously as an actor across the board, and an Oscar nomination for "Tick. Boom!" is a good start. In my opinion, though? He should be swimming in a pool full of trophies every day when he wakes up. Tick. Tick. and he should have Oscars for "The Social Network" and "Tick. but throughout the entire film, he's uniformly excellent as a man whose closest friend is also the most destructive force in his life. Boom!" Because the musical is a Netflix original, you can screen it there and see for yourself.

Diungkapkan bahwa you'd have to go back a little further to pinpoint what might be his most well-known role of all, however. Having worked regularly since the 1990s, the English actor can be seen in a prolific amount of titles over the decades. Some notable examples include Martin Scorsese's "Gangs of New York," the Wachowski Sisters' "V for Vendetta," "Mission: Impossible III," "Miami Vice," "The World's End," "Deadpool 2," and far too many more to name.

In short, Marsan is an acting veteran who knew exactly how to breathe life into a newly-arriving figure like Thráin.

Berdasarkan laporan, when a new console arrives, a lot of us rush out to buy one the minute we can afford to. Personality isn’t a draw yet, beyond whatever’s standard. Berdasarkan laporan, some consumers hold out for a special edition console, which might come with a game and special visual enhancements. More recently, Nintendo has offered several beautiful designs for the Switch, and just kicked things off on the Switch 2. Over the years, Nintendo has done a great job of delivering in this area, going back to the colorful “Play It Loud” versions of the original Game Boy and some tempting Nintendo 64 variants. Here are six of the best-looking special editions.

Diungkapkan bahwa sometimes, it feels like japan gets all the cool stuff. The JoyCons were a lovely blue. The design is somehow both restrained and cute at the same time, much like the Dragon Quest games it celebrates. The hardware featured the standard black dock, with white outlines depicting a legendary sword and shield. But it still feels like a minor tragedy. Each one had a monster near its base (Babble and Slime). It’s easy to understand why Nintendo wouldn’t bother to localize expensive hardware featuring Dragon Quest 11, because the series isn’t nearly as popular in North America and Europe. The back of the handheld unit featured additional decoration, in the form of outlines of beloved monsters from Akira Toriyama, with a few more blue Slime mascots thrown in for good measure. I’ve never imported hardware, but I might have to make an exception.

Sebagaimana diketahui, released alongside super mario 3d world + bowser’s fury, which was sold separately, this basic design had one huge thing going for it: familiar charm. The JoyCon straps feature a yellow widget, and the zippers on an included carrying case are also yellow, like the coins Mario and friends grab on their adventures. The system’s base and shell are Mario red, a color I quite like, and it is accented by a friendly blue that resembles the plumber’s overalls. That carrying case also has a simple print pattern, showing various symbols familiar to anyone who has taken a lot of trips through the Mushroom Kingdom. All in all, despite the apparent lack of ambition, it’s like a warm mug of cocoa on a chilly day.

Berdasarkan laporan, you might expect a lot of color from a special edition modeled after a game like splatoon 3, and mostly that’s what you get (along with the oled version of the hardware, for added brightness). The JoyCons, meanwhile, are vibrant tones of purple and blue on the left side, and green and yellow on the right, also with neat artwork. The system’s base itself is white with gray print, featuring an intricate design that is enhanced by a splotch of bright yellow “paint” on its left portion. The base looks like it just got pegged by a paintball. The effect is very pretty, even if you aren’t super familiar with the IP.

Berdasarkan laporan, the best zelda games are mythical, with strange symbols and patterns scattered around hyrule, and that design translated beautifully to the system capturing the feel of the legend of zelda: tears of the kingdom. The base features Hyrule’s crest, complete with the Triforce, in a white circle at the very center. The JoyCons are predominantly gold themselves, recalling special-edition cartridges Nintendo released early in the series run, but the left one also has a dark green that recalls Link’s strong connection to the forest. To its left and right, basic imagery in a golden tone proves that simple is best. It’s elegant and mysterious in equal measure, and it feels just right.

Berdasarkan laporan, the animal crossing: new horizons console proved difficult to acquire during the initial weeks following its release, largely because no one could have anticipated just what a monster success that game would become. Nintendo had to provide new stock to keep up with the demand. It featured a white base, with blue ocean waves printed along its base. It couldn’t have hurt that the hardware was so adorable. On a small island stood three tanuki characters: Tom Nook and his Nooklings, alongside a palm tree. Besides that soothing imagery, the device also offered pastel green and blue JoyCons, which perfectly evoke the idyllic island setting where the game takes place.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the special edition switch 2 console for the legend of zelda: ocarina of time is the first of its kind for nintendo’s latest hardware, which makes it the best-looking by default. It looks nearly as gorgeous as the new take on Hyrule in the game itself, which is not included. Golden rings circle the analog sticks. Hopefully, Nintendo will produce more units to meet the demand, especially now that the game has shifted more than 5 million units in less than a month. The lack of the game hasn’t stopped resellers from doing their thing, ensuring the console costs more than your average collector might want to pay. Its two JoyCons are a deep metallic green, with Triforce shapes printed in still darker tones, along with a golden print on the left one. An ornate Triforce pattern appears at the very center, with faded echoes extending left. The console’s base is half black and half gold, with triangle-shaped print along its right side. That’s a distinction it is likely to retain, thanks to a stylish design. People are clearly all about Zelda this year, and the special edition console is the perfect way to celebrate that moment.

#174. Victorian Psycho Review: Maika Monroe Goes Crazy In This Erratic Mix Of Humor And Horror

📅 12 Nov 2026

Victorian Psycho Review: Maika Monroe Goes Crazy In This Erratic Mix Of Humor And Horror

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2313694/victorian-psycho-review-maika-monroe-horror-movie/

Diungkapkan bahwa horror-comedies tend to lean heavier on the "comedy" side of things than the "horror. It makes for an erratic viewing experience — you begin to feel the film would be better served staying in one lane rather than trying to make concepts like dead babies funny. " But Zachary Wigon's "Victorian Psycho" attempts to do the opposite, giving the audience a gaggle of gruesome, unsettling moments punctuated by wry humor. Regardless, "Victorian Psycho" mostly succeeds due to Maika Monroe, who gives everything she's got as Winifred Notty, a psychotic governess who moves in with a wealthy family and proceeds to pile up a body count.

Sebagaimana diketahui, her attempt at an english accent may be a bit spotty, but monroe's commitment to playing crazy ultimately works, and works well. not well. If the film's title (an obvious nod to "American Psycho") wasn't a dead giveaway, it's clear from the jump that Winifred is. Her wry narration guides us through outlandish, blood-drenched moments as she spins a twisted tale. A suspicious past follows her as she arrives at Ensor House, inhabited by the Pounds family.

Diungkapkan bahwa winifred may be deranged, but the poundses aren't exactly a pleasant bunch. Mr. Pounds (Ruth Wilson) is cruel and ruthless with the staff, and the children Andrew (Jacobi Jupe) and Drusilla (Evie Templeton) have their own issues (Andrew is a brat destined to grow up to be a bully and Drusilla is more than a little creepy). Pounds (Jason Isaacs) is oblivious, Mrs. A sane person would take one look at the Pounds family and head for the hills, but of course, Winifred isn't sane.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's plenty of room for fun here, but "victorian psycho" is never confident enough in what it's trying to do. The performances are all very broad and big, save for the always-welcomed Thomasin McKenzie, playing the good-natured but clueless nurse Ms. Lamb, who becomes Winifred's only real friend (and instantly buys into her quickly concocted story about a ghoul roaming the grounds of Ensor House).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as big and over-the-top as many of the elements here are, "victorian psycho" also seems to be trying to make a point about the subjugation of women in polite society. Yet it has no real insight into this beyond a surface level approach, and it's hard to get caught up in any sort of message when the film is also constantly pointing out how ridiculous everything here is.

Diungkapkan bahwa wigon, who previously directed "sanctuary," piles on some energetic camerawork that frequently mirrors winifred's fractured mind, but the script by virginia feito, adapting her own novel, relies too much on incessant narration that's not nearly as funny as it should be. And yet, "Victorian Psycho" remains perpetually watchable primarily due to Monroe's performance. A certified scream queen at this point in her career, it's a lot of fun to see Monroe cut loose and swing an axe at people's heads.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "victorian psycho" is just a little too unstable for its own good. There's a specific reason why Winifred has shown up at Ensor House, but the slow reveal of what's going on here feels undercooked. And when the film reaches its grand guignol finale, Wigon inexplicably starts pulling punches, robbing "Victorian Psycho" of a more satisfying conclusion and instead attempting something far more serious and dramatic than everything we've seen so far.

Berdasarkan laporan, what this all comes down to is me wanting to like "victorian psycho" a lot more than i ultimately did. I enjoyed Monroe's performance, and the film's morbidly funny atmosphere, but I came away from it all a tad unsatisfied. There's a ghoulish charm to the narrative, but the blood and guts of something far better is lurking somewhere in here, just out of sight.

"Victorian Psycho" opens in theaters on November 13, 2026.

It's a declaration of purpose and bravado.

Alex Consani at the 2026 LACMA Art + Film gala.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’m putting work into being a better actress. It’s a really exciting endeavor for me, especially considering all the projects that I’ve done that are coming out. Alex Consani with Sarah Paulson (left) and Leslie Grossman (right) in the sixth episode of American Horror Story: 13.

You and I are from the generations that grew up on Ryan Murphy shows.

Diungkapkan bahwa coven, for me, is my favorite american horror story season by far. What was it like to join the project? Did you audition? Did you get a call?.

Diungkapkan bahwa what i find so exciting about it is that it doesn’t feel as exclusive as fashion does, in a way. Berdasarkan laporan, i was reading the artist’s way, which, not to be all corny, i think i realized that the feeling of gratification and the feeling of completing something is only as good as that feeling. I’m very “divine timing” when it comes to this stuff, so I believe everything will happen and run its course in the way it should. But there’s also a lot of really interesting biopics that I would love to see. Maybe I write them, maybe I act. Who knows?.

Consani arriving at the Los Angeles County Museum of Art.

So you want to get into writing too, or have you been writing?.

Diungkapkan bahwa totally. I think he’s an incredible director. My favorite part about working with Janicza was just the youth in her perspective. I’ve worked with multi-generations of directors at this point, and to see the difference between how Ryan works versus how Janicza works versus how Molly Gordon works, it’s just quite interesting. She’s so incredible with the way that she thinks. Wes Anderson is a really big one. I love Wes Anderson. There’s a lot of directors that I’m a big fan of, people who are obviously focused on cinematography, but also understand how to have fun.

#182. 5 Sci-Fi Book Trilogies Where Every Entry Is Perfect

📅 13 Nov 2026

5 Sci-Fi Book Trilogies Where Every Entry Is Perfect

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/sci-fi-trilogy-perfect-entries/

The best sci-fi stories come in groups of three.

Sebagaimana diketahui, trilogies are a popular book format for a reason. Trilogies allow writers to flesh out their worlds, creating enough breathing room for genre concepts and important events. Apart from naturally satisfying the rule of three, they also naturally mimic the classic structure of a beginning, middle, and end. The same logic is particularly true for science fiction. Dystopian sci-fi books like The Hunger Games use the trilogy structure to map out the painstaking moving parts of a rebellion, while the Broken Earth science-fantasy trilogy encompasses a massive supercontinent full of complex lore.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, not all sci-fi trilogies are created equal. But there are plenty of perfect trilogies, too. Polygon has rounded up five sci-fi book trilogies that are worth your time from start to finish. Plenty start strong only to flame out in book two or three, while others admittedly take a while to get good. Check out the list below.

Diungkapkan bahwa william gibson’s neuromancer is often at the forefront of brilliant cyberpunk book lists, given how foundational the text is for the genre. The first novel drops the reader in the midst of a bustling, neon-tinted city, where a console cowboy (hacker) named Case is forced into pulling off a heist in exchange for his continued survival. Its sequels, Count Zero and Mona Lisa Overdrive, tend to get overlooked in the process, even though these entries are as exceptional as Neuromancer. A sentient AI named Wintermute emerges as an antagonist, with Count Zero detailing the aftermath of the heist, and Mona Lisa Overdrive exposing the rotten core of a hyper-technological world.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sprawl is the definition of “show, don’t tell. Sprawl is also a bleak, uncompromising look at corporate oppression, a sentiment that has inspired the core conflict in everything from The Matrix to Cyberpunk 2077. On the contrary, it invites the reader to decipher context cues and retains interest with strong character portraits. This doesn’t mean Sprawl isn’t immersive. ” This is a double-edged sword, as Gibson’s vivid prose can often feel more sensory than descriptive, making it unsuited for brisk reading. This aspect is substantial enough, but Sprawl drives it home with a reflective ending that makes human presence irrelevant to the progress of machine intelligence.

Diungkapkan bahwa although isaac asimov added two sequels and two prequels to the foundation novel series after 1953, the core concept was conceived as a trilogy. Seldon foresees the fall of the Empire, a lengthy dark age, and the eventual rise of a second empire. These novels — Foundation, Foundation and Empire, and Second Foundation — are set in the final days of a Galactic Empire, where mathematician Hari Seldon uses a special technique called psychohistory to predict the future. He decides to shorten the projected number of years between the rise and fall of a dynasty.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, asimov’s narrative scope in the foundation novels is massive. For Seldon, history becomes a malleable timeline instead of a fixed inevitability, which has its repercussions on the galaxy at large. The novels follow the fall of a 12,000-year-old Galactic Empire, which has been shaped by sociopolitical factors that cannot be erased by history on a whim. Seldon’s plan to shorten the duration of the dark age is grand and unprecedented, but it is one that causes repeated issues over time. The math, although solid, contains variables that were previously unaccounted for, turning the Foundation trilogy into a tense psychological mystery that plays by the rules of sci-fi.

Diungkapkan bahwa liu cixin creates a dense, compelling case for the limits of human nature and how these limits can be overcome through cold logic. Cixin’s Three-Body Problem offers a solid base for this idea, which turns into a full-blown conversation about civilizational entropy and cosmic forces in The Dark Forest and Death’s End. These complicated events begin with a disillusioned young woman named Ye Wenjie, who dooms humanity by inviting an alien race known as the Trisolarans to invade the planet. As the Trisolarans experience a vicious cycle of destruction and rebirth due to the three suns that orbit their system, Earth becomes both a source of salvation and a target for colonization.

Berdasarkan laporan, remembrance of earth’s past is full of promising characters like wang miao and luo ji, but cixin is more interested in representing humanity as a collective species. This leaves us vulnerable to threats of a cosmic scale. Not only are we horribly underprepared to deal with such a crisis, but we are also destined to perish according to the laws of science. Although internal differences remain, humanity is fundamentally driven by a need to survive, but this impulse is short-term. This fragility is at the core of Remembrance of Earth’s Past, which argues that the only way to adapt is to keep transcending at the cost of leaving our “human” identities behind.

Berdasarkan laporan, formerly known as the xenogenesis trilogy, octavia e. Butler’s Lilith’s Brood comprises Dawn, Adulthood Rites, and Imago. The story opens with a woman named Lilith being unable to recall her past, although she vaguely remembers a planet-wide catastrophic event and an accident that killed her family. Over time, Lilith realizes that an alien race known as the Oankali rescued a few survivors from an irradiated Earth, leaving humanity no choice but to evolve into a completely different species.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lilith’s brood is a radical inversion of traditional “first contact” sci-fi tales. Instead, they propose a genetic trade, giving humans the choice to “upgrade” themselves, although this freedom to choose feels like an illusion. Earth is already uninhabitable, so the Oankali aren’t interested in inheriting a new planet or ruling over its people. The Oankali perceive humanity as paranoid, self-destructive beings who are also capable of high intelligence and deep empathy. This contradiction is at the heart of the series, as we’re left to wonder whether a forced evolution makes humanity lose these traits to the point that they become unrecognizable in their own eyes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a sprawling look at the settlement and terraforming of mars, kim stanley robinson’s mars trilogy offers hard sci-fi realism. The science is mostly authentic, as Robinson is more preoccupied with the nuanced developments made on Mars while the condition on Earth deteriorates due to overpopulation and environmental disasters. The books (Red Mars, Blue Mars, and Green Mars) follow a group of colonists who are part of a joint American-Russian undertaking, and how they manage to build their first settlement on Mars and its hollowed-out moon.

Diungkapkan bahwa the mars trilogy is a multi-generational look at the rise of a new society. Rebuilding society from scratch is no walk in the park; the planet’s terrain proves to be a challenge, along with continental ice-melt floods. There’s also the human aspect of it all, as such a high-stakes project comes with conflict. Even in the absence of conflict, humans are entangled in their own unique problems, which the books unravel with the same interest as they do the scientific aspects of the resettlement. A rapidly declining Earth also becomes the point of focus, as the comparatively utopian life on Mars reminds humans how they ruined a perfectly hospitable planet tailor-made for their survival.

In addition, large chunks of Foundation were simply ripped off from the history of 6th century Byzantium.
